sentences.en: The FBI thwarted an assassination attempt against Mayor Matt Brown.
sentences.zh: 1. FBI挫败了对市长马特·布朗的暗杀企图。

sentences.en: Assassination has never changed the history of the world.
sentences.zh: 2. 暗杀从未改变过世界历史。

sentences.en: The mystery of Matoub Lounes's assassination hasn't been solved.
sentences.zh: 3. 马图卜·卢内斯遇刺案的谜团仍未解开。
